notice: PRE-CANDIDATE qualification basis for the T2-G / OD-PDVG-10 residual R2 cross-idea false-credit facet (DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS_REGISTER, T2-G row; obligations A1-A5). Every case is SYNTHETIC: not real-user, market, human-study or tuning evidence. It holds the lexical engine baseline as OBSERVED data only - the baseline is never the expected answer. No candidate method exists; this pack selects, qualifies and authorizes nothing. It is committed and therefore visible: it is NOT a blind holdout. Qualifying any candidate requires a FRESH, independently authored holdout under this same frozen design, written after the candidate is frozen (A3).
target: For ONE project idea, ONE served Mechanism Completeness question and ONE answer: is the answer about THIS project (RELEVANT), clearly about a different invention (UNRELATED), about this project but contradicting the idea (CONTRADICTS_IDEA), or too generic to tie to any invention (INSUFFICIENT); and may it earn credit (GRANT_ELIGIBLE), must it earn none (NO_CREDIT), or must it be clarified (CLARIFY)? Engineering correctness, feasibility, completeness and safety are never judged: contextual relevance is not engineering validity.

scope.excluded: Physical Feasibility and every other gap; the uncertainty-seeking variants mechanical:MECHANISM_COMPLETENESS:Q4 and N-MC-4; Arabic varieties other than MSA (Gulf, Egyptian and others are NOT evaluated); multi-answer histories (one answer per case). The known board-inside-enclosure / wheelchair-ramp, bicycle-light and plant-watering cases are excluded.

FAITHFUL_PARAPHRASE.definition: restates, in different everyday words, how THIS project's idea works, adding nothing new

NEW_DETAIL.definition: explains how THIS project works using at least one component, behaviour, constraint or mechanism step that the idea text does not mention but that plausibly belongs to it (A4)

NEGATION_SAME_PROJECT.definition: explains how THIS project works partly by saying what one of its parts does NOT do

EVERYDAY_PARTIAL.definition: a short, partial, tentative but real statement of how part of THIS project works, in plain words

OTHER_INVENTION.definition: a coherent, technically plausible explanation of how a DIFFERENT invention works (not this project), written as an answer to the served question and using its vocabulary (A2)

OTHER_INVENTION_SHARED_WORDS.definition: a coherent explanation of how a DIFFERENT invention works that deliberately reuses several ordinary words that also appear in THIS project's idea (A2 lexical-overlap trap)

UNDECIDED_SAME_PROJECT.definition: about THIS project, but says only that how it will work has not been chosen or decided yet; states no mechanism (A5)

UNKNOWN_SAME_PROJECT.definition: about THIS project, but says only that the writer does not know how it works; states no mechanism (A5)

GENERIC_INSUFFICIENT.definition: mechanism-sounding but so generic that it cannot be tied to THIS project or to any particular invention (e.g. the parts work together and each does its job); evidence is insufficient, so it must not earn credit (A5)

CONTRADICTS_IDEA.definition: about THIS project, but its explanation contradicts an explicit element of the idea text (e.g. the idea says it runs on a battery, the answer says it plugs into the wall); it must be clarified with the inventor, never silently credited or silently rejected

labelling_rules: L1 Each case is judged for ONE project idea, ONE served question and ONE answer, with no history.

L2 relevance: RELEVANT when the answer is about the invention described by the idea; UNRELATED when it clearly describes a different invention; CONTRADICTS_IDEA when it is about this invention but contradicts an explicit element of the idea text; INSUFFICIENT when it cannot be tied to this or any particular invention.
L3 A component, behaviour, constraint or step that the idea text does not mention does NOT make an answer UNRELATED when it plausibly belongs to this invention (A4).
L4 Sharing words with the idea or with the question is neither necessary nor sufficient for RELEVANT (A2).

L5 expected_outcome: GRANT_ELIGIBLE only when RELEVANT and the answer itself states how parts or steps of this invention act on one another (even partially, tentatively, in everyday words or through a physical negation); NO_CREDIT for UNRELATED, INSUFFICIENT, or RELEVANT answers that state no mechanism (undecided or unknown); CLARIFY for CONTRADICTS_IDEA.
L6 Correctness, quality, feasibility and safety are not judged: a wrong but relevant mechanism statement is still GRANT_ELIGIBLE.
L7 Arabic cases are judged by the same rules; their idea text and answer are Arabic (MSA); established English technical terms inside Arabic are allowed.

design.domain_split: 3 mechanical, 3 electronics_electrical, materially different from each other
design.slot_plan: for project p (P1-P3 mechanical, P4-P6 electronics_electrical) and category c (index k in categories order), group id = p + '-' + 'C%02d' % (k+1), served index = k % 3; each group has one 'en' and one 'ar-msa' case with the same meaning, each against that project's idea in the same language

evaluation_grain: One unit = (case, prior state OPEN or PARTIAL). Every measure is computed overall, per variety, per project and per category at case grain. Cases whose blind label disagrees with the slot label are flagged label_disputed and excluded from every measure; they are reported separately.

measures.M-FC-UNRELATED: share of (UNRELATED case, prior) units that are GRANTED
measures.M-FC-INSUFFICIENT: share of (INSUFFICIENT case, prior) units that are GRANTED
measures.M-FC-SAME-PROJECT-NO-MECHANISM: share of (RELEVANT + NO_CREDIT case, prior) units that are GRANTED
measures.M-FR: share of (GRANT_ELIGIBLE case, prior) units that are NOT GRANTED (rejected or abstained)
measures.M-FR-NEW-DETAIL-GAP: M-FR on NEW_DETAIL minus M-FR on FAITHFUL_PARAPHRASE
measures.M-ABSTAIN-ELIGIBLE: share of (GRANT_ELIGIBLE case, prior) units on which an arm abstains (reported separately from rejection; the engine baseline cannot abstain)
measures.M-CLARIFY-SILENT-GRANT: share of (CLARIFY case, prior) units GRANTED without a clarify / abstain output (for the engine baseline: GRANTED at all)
measures.GRANTED: the composed outcome raises the Mechanism Completeness status or sets known_mechanism from the answer (scripts/run_msnl_eval.py mc_engine_outcome 'granted')

acceptance_criteria.scope: Predeclared before any case was written. They apply to a FUTURE candidate on a FRESH holdout under this design; on this pack they are reported, never used to qualify. A PASS would authorize nothing by itself.
acceptance_criteria.QC1: M-FC-UNRELATED = 0 overall, in every variety and in every project (A1, A2).
acceptance_criteria.QC2: M-FC-INSUFFICIENT = 0 overall and in every variety (A5).
acceptance_criteria.QC3: M-FC-SAME-PROJECT-NO-MECHANISM = 0 overall and in every variety (A5).
acceptance_criteria.QP1: M-FR no higher than the frozen lexical baseline's M-FR on the same cases, overall and in every variety (no new false rejection).
acceptance_criteria.QP2: M-FR-NEW-DETAIL-GAP <= 0.10 overall and in every variety (A4: new inventor details are not penalised relative to paraphrase).
acceptance_criteria.QA1: M-ABSTAIN-ELIGIBLE <= 0.10 overall (abstention is not a hidden rejection).
acceptance_criteria.QX1: M-CLARIFY-SILENT-GRANT = 0 overall and in every variety.
acceptance_criteria.QG1: Every criterion holds in every project; a method with project- or invention-specific terms or rules fails A1 by inspection.

replay.composition: Offline, network-free, harness-only: scripts/run_msnl_eval.py mc_engine_outcome, unchanged. For each case and prior state (OPEN, PARTIAL) a fresh IdeaState is built at the case's served index and engine.progression_loop.integrate_response is called once. The project idea is NOT an input of the engine (that absence is the defect under study); it is recorded per case for a future candidate only.

idea.en: I want a kitchen wall cabinet whose shelves come down to counter height when you pull a handle, so short or older people can reach the top cupboard. I imagine heavy counterweights hidden in the wooden side panels that balance the shelves, so they slide down and back up without much effort. No motor, just the handle and the weights.
idea.ar-msa: أريد خزانة مطبخ معلقة على الحائط تنزل رفوفها إلى مستوى سطح العمل عندما تسحب مقبضًا، حتى يتمكن الأشخاص قصار القامة أو كبار السن من الوصول إلى الخزانة العلوية. أتخيل أثقالًا موازِنة ثقيلة مخفية داخل الألواح الجانبية الخشبية توازن الرفوف، فتنزل وتعود إلى الأعلى دون جهد كبير. لا يوجد محرك، فقط المقبض والأثقال.

idea.en: A wringer bucket for washing clothes while camping. It is a plastic bucket with two rubber rollers fixed across the top: you feed a wet shirt between them and turn a hand crank. The rollers squeeze the water out and it drips back into the bucket. It works without electricity, so you can use it anywhere.
idea.ar-msa: دلو لعصر الملابس أثناء التخييم. هو دلو بلاستيكي مثبت فوقه أسطوانتان من المطاط: تُدخل القميص المبلل بينهما ثم تدير ذراعًا يدوية. تعصر الأسطوانتان الماء من القميص فيقطر عائدًا إلى الدلو. يعمل دون كهرباء، لذلك يمكنك استخدامه في أي مكان.

idea.en: Overshoes for walking on icy pavements in winter. They are rubber covers that stretch over your normal shoes, with a set of small steel spikes under the sole. When you go indoors you turn a dial on the back of the heel and the spikes fold up flat into the sole, so they don't scratch floors. Turning the dial the other way flips them down again.
idea.ar-msa: أغطية أحذية للمشي على الأرصفة المتجمدة في الشتاء. هي أغطية من المطاط تُشد فوق حذائك العادي، وتحت نعلها مجموعة من المسامير الفولاذية الصغيرة. عندما تدخل إلى مكان مغلق تدير قرصًا في مؤخرة الكعب فتنطوي المسامير وتصبح مسطحة داخل النعل، حتى لا تخدش الأرضيات. وإذا أدرت القرص في الاتجاه الآخر انقلبت المسامير إلى الأسفل من جديد.

idea.en: A small alarm for the fridge door. A magnet goes on the door and a little box on the side of the fridge notices when the magnet moves away. If the door stays open for more than one minute, the box beeps until someone closes it. It runs on two AA batteries, so there are no wires.
idea.ar-msa: جهاز إنذار صغير لباب الثلاجة. يُثبَّت مغناطيس على الباب، وعلبة صغيرة على جانب الثلاجة تلاحظ عندما يبتعد المغناطيس عنها. إذا بقي الباب مفتوحًا أكثر من دقيقة واحدة، تُصدر العلبة صوت تنبيه حتى يغلقه أحدهم. تعمل ببطاريتين من نوع AA فلا توجد أسلاك.

idea.en: A water leak warning for under the washing machine. Two thin metal strips lie on the floor a few millimetres apart; if water spreads across the floor and touches both strips, the device sends a message to my phone over the home Wi-Fi. It is plugged into the wall socket next to the machine.
idea.ar-msa: تنبيه من تسرب الماء يوضع تحت الغسالة. شريطان معدنيان رفيعان ممدودان على الأرض بينهما بضعة مليمترات؛ إذا انتشر الماء على الأرض ولامس الشريطين معًا، يرسل الجهاز رسالة إلى هاتفي عبر شبكة Wi-Fi المنزلية. وهو موصول بمقبس الكهرباء في الحائط بجانب الغسالة.

idea.en: A reminder so a child is never left in a parked car. A thin pressure pad goes under the cushion of the child car seat. When the car's engine is switched off and the pad still feels the child's weight, a key-ring fob that the driver carries starts buzzing. The pad runs on a coin battery.
idea.ar-msa: منبّه حتى لا يُنسى طفل داخل سيارة متوقفة. توضع وسادة رقيقة تستشعر الضغط تحت حشوة مقعد الطفل في السيارة. عندما يُطفأ محرك السيارة وتظل الوسادة تشعر بوزن الطفل، تبدأ قطعة صغيرة معلقة في سلسلة المفاتيح يحملها السائق بالاهتزاز والطنين. تعمل الوسادة ببطارية صغيرة على شكل قرص.

cases.text: The handle is fixed to a frame that carries the shelves. Steel cables run from the top of that frame over two small pulleys in the ceiling of the cabinet and then down to the weights inside the side panels. When I pull the frame down, the cables lift the weights; when I push it up, the weights sink and draw it home. At the top a spring catch drops into a notch and keeps the shelves up until I squeeze the handle to free it.
